title: ACH Autopay Courtesy Schedule — Final Month of an Independent Living Residency
content:
A settling residency under the Independent Living Residency Agreement that pays by ACH autopay receives an autopay courtesy on the final month's base fee charge, counted over the payments posted on the residency within the 12 months ending on the day of posting.

## Schedule

| Payments posted within the 12 months | Autopay courtesy |
|---|---|
| Every such payment was an ACH autopay payment | 1.0 percent |
| Some but not all were ACH autopay payments | 0.5 percent |
| None was an ACH autopay payment, or no payment was posted | None |

The payment method of each payment entry decides whether it was an ACH autopay payment; one-time ACH payments, checks and card payments are not.

## Application

The courtesy percentage reduces the final month's base fee charge before rounding. Several courtesy percentages on one charge are added into one total that reduces the charge once, never one after another, and the result is rounded once to the cent half up.

## Hypothetical cases

- Twelve monthly payments in the 12 months, all by ACH autopay: 1.0 percent.
- Eleven by ACH autopay and one by personal check: 0.5 percent.
- All by personal check: none.
- A charge of 2,000.00 before rounding with an autopay courtesy of 0.5 percent as its only courtesy: 1,990.00.
